items.title: A check, not a show
items.body:
This is the week boss. You already met these errors. You are only proving you can name them.

1. **Tags do not match** :  you deleted a closing tag in Text.
2. **Lost file** :  it lived on the desktop.
3. **Empty title** :  the page has no name.

Fail the quiz and **week 2 stays locked**. Retry as many times as you want. The 5-minute warmup does not open the week.

items.title: One line about later
items.body: Adobe has a website tool used by another team. You will open that in **week 9**. Not now. Do not mix it with Oxygen in your notes.

items.title: Tone
items.body: Red errors are normal. Repair them. Then go home.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Three breaks, three repairs.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You cannot say what one of the three errors meant, or you leave the check copy broken.

Expected: Check copy opens clean. Three one-line notes about the three breaks.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Three breaks, three repairs.
blocks.intro: How to Three breaks, three repairs. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Three breaks, three repairs
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy your week1 folder to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week1-check/ so you do not wreck the original.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Break 1: delete a closing tag in Text. Read the red error. Undo.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Break 2: put the file on the desktop in your head :  actually move a copy to the desktop, then move it back into the folder. Write why the desktop is a bad home.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Break 3: clear the title, save, read the error or the empty tab, put the title back.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: The page must open with no red error when you stop.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Pass the quiz. You can retry it. Week 2 stays locked until this day is finished (lab + quiz + a short note).
